rendering.projection: orthographic projection after arbitrary combined object rotations
rendering.vector_output: image.svg uses explicit SVG polygons and text labels
rendering.raster_output: image.png is rendered at 1x from the same geometry, 2500x2500px
rendering.layout: two target panels plus four choice panels all use the same panel size

view_selection.view_selection_policy: sampled deterministic non-right-angle rotations; target pair maximizes visible-cell coverage plus view-direction diversity with a duplicate-evidence penalty; component views maximize visibility of changed/witness cells
